MemeDef.label: sword way
MemeDef.description: The sword is neither good nor bad; the hand is. Mastery is won by cutting and tempering the Will of the Sword.

rulesStrings.li: memeAdjective->sword
memeHyphenPrefix->sword
memeConcept->sword way
memeLeaderNoun->blade
creation(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_SwordWay)->[deity0_name] taught the way of the sword way.
episode(uses=1,tag=meme_CVG_Meme_SwordWay)->[deity0_name] showed the first [memberName] the way of the sword way.
intro(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_SwordWay)->The early [memberNamePlural] of the [place_summary] [place_name] built a great [altarName] to [deity0_name].
conflict(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_SwordWay)->A powerful [foeLeader] despised the [memberNamePlural] and their ways.
founderJoin(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_SwordWay)->[memberName]'s savior [founderName] came down from the mountain with nothing but the sword way.
victory(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_SwordWay)->[founderName] faced the [foeLeader] and the [foeSoldiers] fled.
setup(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_SwordWay)->The believers were scattered, so they gathered to follow the sword way.
story(uses=1,tag=meme_CVG_Meme_SwordWay)->The believers spread out and grew in number, each walking the sword way in their own way.
lessonIntro(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_SwordWay)->Disciple, the old masters used to say:
lesson(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_SwordWay)->the sword is neither good nor bad; the hand is. Mastery is won by cutting and tempering the Will of the Sword.
lessonReinforcement(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_SwordWay)->You will understand it after many years of practice.
archistFact(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_SwordWay)->The archotechs watch the sword way as a gardener watches a vine.
archistProphecy(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_SwordWay)->[inTheEnd], the archotechs will depart, and those who followed the sword way will remain.
animistFact(tag=meme_CVG_Meme_SwordWay)->The spirits of the land walk the sword way with us.
